name: What are the common challenges during a room addition project?

mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges during a room addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges during a room addition project can include unexpected structural issues in the existing home, delays in permit approvals, changes in material availability or cost, and unforeseen weather impacts. Maintaining clear communication with your contractor can help manage these challenges. A contingency budget is also advisable to address any unpredicted expenses that may arise during construction.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common challenges include structural surprises, permit delays, material issues, and weather; clear communication and a contingency budget help manage them.
